Credit Suisse, a prestigious Swiss bank and bullion dealer mints, produced the 1 gram Gold Bar Credit Suisse Statue of Liberty (New Assay). The bar features the iconic image of the Statue of Liberty on one side and the weight, purity, and the Credit Suisse logo on the other. The bar is made of 99.99% pure gold, which is considered to be of the highest quality. It is also hallmarked with the new assay card to guarantee its authenticity and quality.
This gold bar is a great option for investors looking for a small, affordable way to invest in gold bullion. The compact size of the bar makes it easy to store, and you can buy it in small quantities. The design of the bar is also very appealing, making it a great addition to any bullion collection.
Design Of Credit Suisse Lady Liberty 1 gram Gold Bar
The Credit Suisse 1 gram Gold Bar design features the weight and purity of the gold (1 gram and 999.9 fine, respectively), and the Credit Suisse logo is also prominently displayed on the obverse side.
The reverse side of the bar features a bold and patriotic portrait of the statue of liberty. This particular bar is also stamped with the “New Assay” mark, which indicates that it has been tested and verified for quality and purity by the Credit Suisse Assay Office. Additionally, the bar comes in a protective plastic case to keep the bar safe and secure.
